current_state: Annual Commitment ($1,550,000) sized to an assumed consumption ramp that has not materialized — Year 1 actual usage is $66,100 (4.3% utilization) against a program plan that does not reach first production use case until Q1 2027.
sourcing_implication: The commitment was priced and sized before the program timeline was known; it now systematically overpays for unconsumed capacity every year until the program catches up.
recommended_action: Re-time the Annual Commitment schedule to the program's actual delivery milestones (a ramp schedule) rather than a flat number.

current_state: Business Critical Support is priced at 22% of the Committed Purchase Amount ($341,000/yr) regardless of actual usage or ticket volume — trailing-quarter ticket volume is 4 low-severity tickets.
sourcing_implication: Support is priced against a hypothetical usage level, not the small pilot footprint actually being supported; Databricks is charging enterprise-scale support economics for pilot-scale operational load.
recommended_action: Re-price support against actual/consumed spend rather than committed spend, or step support in as usage ramps.

current_state: Unused Annual Commitment does not carry forward; ~95.7% of Year 1's committed spend ($1,483,900) is forfeited at the Oct 14, 2026 anniversary, and Year 2 begins with an identical $1,891,000 payment the same day.
sourcing_implication: The no-carry-forward term converts underutilization into a permanent sunk cost instead of letting the ramp catch up naturally; the forfeiture-then-re-pay structure has no cost to Databricks to fix.
recommended_action: Negotiate a carry-forward provision for unused Year 1 commitment into Year 2, retroactive to this contract, ahead of the October 14 payment.

current_state: The commitment is paid directly to Databricks rather than routed through an AWS Marketplace private offer, despite Meridian running the platform on AWS and holding an active AWS EDP.
sourcing_implication: Routing future commitment dollars through AWS Marketplace would let the same spend retire AWS EDP commitment simultaneously, at no cost to either side.
recommended_action: Amend future commitment (Year 2 onward) to route through an AWS Marketplace private offer.
